sentences.text:
Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, the Act, 2013) on the premise that a civil suit namely the Special NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/19667/2023 ORDER DATED:
09/11/2023 undefined Civil Suit No. 28 of 2020 has been filed by the petitioner, which is pending consideration before the competent Court.
The copy of the plaint is not on record.

On a query made by the Court, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the decree of declaration and possession has been sought by the petitioner in the civil suit, which is filed in the year 2020, wherein the respondent Nos. 1 to 4 are impleaded.
It is further contended that the application under Order 7 Rule 11 of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908 filed by the respondent Nos. 1 to 4 had been rejected by the trial Court.
The order of rejection of the said application has been subject to challenge before this Court in appeal, wherein further proceeding in the suit has been stayed.
2. Be that as it may, the fact remains that the petitioner is seeking a decree of declaration and the civil suit is pending.
As on date, the petitioner cannot establish his right in the property in question without there being any decree of the civil suit.

Be that as it may, it is open for the petitioner to seek appropriate relief with reference to the disbursement of compensation to the respondent Nos. 1 to 4,
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/19667/2023 ORDER DATED: 09/11/2023 undefined whose names were admittedly reflected in the revenue records at the time of acquisition.
3. The prayer to quash the award dated 30.09.2020 is thus, misconceived.
The present petition is dismissed accordingly.
Liberty is with the petitioner to seek appropriate relief before the Civil Court.

It is further clarified that in case the petitioner approaches the Civil Court, it would be required to give an independent consideration to the claim of the petitioner, without being influenced by any of the observations made herein above.
[ Sunita Agarwal, CJ. ] [ Aniruddha P. Mayee, J. ] hiren /13
